provenance.source: Assumed effective payload throughput in bytes/ns for the bound system-to-local path; not measured DDR bandwidth.
Assumed effective ns per public transfer/core-delivery activity including lock/setup. Public transfers may coalesce to fewer runtime BDs; this is not runtime-BD or physical DMA latency.
Assumed effective ns per source load/store including correlated indexing/local-loop work; no independent memory-bank calibration.
Assumed ns per logical nonconstant arith/math source operation of the scalar implementation; not instruction-level latency.
Assumed fixed local task-instance/loop entry work, excluding explicit transfers and group configuration.
Assumed40000ns per explicit execution group. Magnitude is informed by old coupled stage effects, but is NOT transferred isolated configuration calibration.
Assumed completion observation/FROM-sync/host return envelope per invocation, excluding separately priced device work.
Assumed prepared-call entry/TO-sync/host dispatch envelope per actual shared invocation, excluding device work and group setup.
Assumed zero separate price because visibility/ABI work is owned by the host entry/return envelopes, not because physical synchronization is free.

cost_model.scope: Explicit assumption-driven resource-scheduled search objective, not a calibrated or validated ranking model. Same parameters for all program/candidate shapes; no per-program total-time fitting. v19 reuses all nine numeric assumptions unchanged; not device calibration.
